description.en: Native agent control for the DSH right-sidebar browser. Registers sidebar_browser for tab management (status, list, open, navigate, reload, focus, close) and sidebar_page for page work (read text, interactive elements or HTML, click, type, press, scroll, wait, run JavaScript, screenshot). Operates the Electron webview directly, without Playwright, Puppeteer or a proxy.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧栏原生浏览器提供 Agent 操作能力。注册 sidebar_browser 管理标签页（status、list、open、navigate、reload、focus、close），sidebar_page 读取文本、交互元素或 HTML，并支持点击、输入、按键、滚动、等待、执行 JavaScript 与截图。直接操作 Electron webview，不使用 Playwright、Puppeteer 或代理。
